gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-cham: Pipe-cleaner curves with a commanding grin, that's Righteous all over. Noto Sans Cham follows with tall rounded lowercase and generous c entries, a sans-serif that feels clean and modern.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee reads friendly, short stalks rising over a tall letter band. Righteous draws each stroke like a drawn cable, while the body text keeps its wide-gapped e flowing through paragraphs.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Righteous holds one unbroken line weight from terminals to junctions, with bowls that fill the line. But Noto Sans Coptic is the text worker, with a dominant middle zone and uncrowded s and c.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Noto Sans Devanagari has a g with an open lower curve and a compact skyline. Yet Righteous makes the statement, its curves matching its stems in weight, while the other keeps quiet.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Monoline skeleton, big personality, every bowl filling the line: that's Righteous. The standout quality is how Noto Sans Duployan, a sans-serif with a wide-mouthed a and oversized counters, gives that loud heading room.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Compass-pencil consistency, bowls that fill the line, a loud little personality: that's Righteous. Noto Sans Kaithi, with its open e channel and capital-like lowercase, sits beside it like a quieter sibling.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Loud, curvy and sure of itself, that's Righteous with bowls filling the line. Righteous gives its s a spine as hefty as its ends, while Noto Sans Kannada opens its s curves wide and keeps capitals gently taller.
